title: Twi'lek Majordomo
subtitle: Independent
description: As the majordomo to Mok Shaiz, the mayor of Mos Espa, Tatooine, this fast-talking Twi'lek was as charismatic as he was finely dressed. After Jabba the Hutt's territory was taken over by Boba Fett and Fennec Shand, the slick weasel of a majordomo found himself in the middle of a battle over Mos Espa itself and on the run from the notorious Fett himself.
